How we roll

Three ways to make
the roads dangerous.

We value awareness, teamwork, and players who move with purpose. Pick up your role, listen to comms, and help the squad control the fight.

01 / AMBUSH

Ganking

Track targets, set clean catches, and turn good calls into decisive kills. Patience first; burst when it counts.

Catch • Lock • Finish
02 / COORDINATION

7-Man Small Scale

Compact groups, clear calls, and focused engages. Every cooldown matters when seven players move as one.

Comms • Timing • Teamplay
03 / PURSUIT

Tracking

Follow the trail, read the terrain, and stay alert. We head out ready to find action instead of waiting for it.

Scout • Pursue • Engage
